verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, and separately documents its HTTP management API. Nothing in the evidence says the reference is interactive (e.g. a try-it console) or includes runnable examples. The probe found no machine-readable spec at the common paths, but it did not check the /api reference page, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: evidence the reference is interactive, runnable examples or try-it functionality, a reachable OpenAPI spec file, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: A public Management API for every Jitsu instance, with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api.
Jitsu exposes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions.
